#!/bin/sh
set -eu
root="$HOME/ji-stage6-performance-final2"
test ! -e "$root"
mkdir -p "$root/runtime" "$root/data"
tar -xzf "$HOME/ji-stage6-performance-final2.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C "$root/runtime"
chmod 0755 "$root/runtime/bin/ji-stage6-testkit"
docker run -d --name ji-stage6-performance-final2 \
  --cpus 2 --memory 4g --memory-swap 4g \
  -v "$root:/stage6" -w /stage6 eclipse-temurin:21-jre-jammy \
  ./runtime/bin/ji-stage6-testkit performance data >/dev/null
docker inspect ji-stage6-performance-final2 \
  --format 'STAGE6_PERFORMANCE_STARTED {{.State.Status}} {{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} {{.HostConfig.Memory}} {{.HostConfig.MemorySwap}}'
